plan.notes: Source 1 (semesters 2-4): https://catalog.sunybroome.edu/preview_program.php?catoid=23&poid=2322&print (official 2024-2025 Official General Catalog, 'Program: Computer Science: A.S.', CIP 11.0701, 'Graduation Requirement: 63 Credits'). Hand-transcribed 2026-09-30 from the catalog page's official term-by-term sequence. Source 2 (Fall Year 1 semester): https://sunybroome.edu/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/suny_oneonta_computer_science_articulation_spring_2024.pdf (official signed articulation agreement between SUNY Broome and SUNY Oneonta, A.S. in Computer Science, effective Fall 2024, hosted on sunybroome.edu) -- its 'Fall Semester 1' table gives the full first-semester course list; cross-checked against the signed SUNY Oswego B.A. Computer Science articulation on sunybroome.edu, which lists the same Fall 1 courses (PED Elective 1 cr, CST 113 Introduction to Programming, CST 117 Problem Solving & Communication Tools, CST 119 Computer Concepts & Applications, ENG 110 College Writing I, MAT 181 Calculus I = 17 cr). The online catalog program page does not render a Fall Year 1 semester list (its 'First Year' section starts at Spring Semester); 63 - 16 - 17 - 13 = 17 cr is exactly the Fall Semester 1 total in the official articulation, so nothing is invented -- every course, title, and credit comes from an official Broome document. TRUE degree verified: 'Computer Science: A.S.', Associate in Science (not AA). The program description recommends a Precalculus background to finish in two years; students needing preparatory courses may take longer and those credits do not count toward the degree. The 2024-2025 catalog marks CST 150, CST 202, and CST 225 as writing-emphasis (W) courses; the 'W' suffix is omitted from codes here. No official per-course prerequisite data is published in either term-by-term source, so all prereq arrays are empty rather than invented; external_prereqs is empty. Term credit totals per official sources: Fall Y1 17, Spring Y1 16, Fall Y2 17, Spring Y2 13 = 63, matching the catalog's published graduation requirement of 63 credits.
